Practice for Friday’s Criterion A quiz

How to write an effect answer

A strong answer has three parts:

1. The featurePoint to exactly what you see on the page.
2. The termName the convention, for example close up or caption.
3. The effectExplain what it makes the reader feel, notice or understand.
Sentence frame: The creator uses ______ (term) to show ______. This makes the reader feel / notice ______ because ______.
Warm up

Upgrade the answer

Three students wrote about this panel from page 137:

Answer A: “It shows a coin.”
Answer B: “The creator uses a close up of the coin.”
Answer C: “The creator uses a close up of the shining gold coin in a gloved hand, so the reader looks only at the treasure. The bright yellow against the plain background shows this is the object the whole mission was about.”
